entries.title: Aion 3.0 Mini
entries.summary: Aion 3.0 Mini, Aion Labs' compact multi-model reasoning model built on the DeepSeek family, joins the catalog on five BYOK routes with a 131K-token context.

entries.title: Aion 3.5
entries.summary: Aion 3.5, Aion Labs' multi-model reasoning model for fiction writing, joins the catalog on five BYOK routes with a 262K-token context.

entries.title: Hy-MT2 1.8B
entries.summary: Hy-MT2 1.8B, the smallest model in Tencent's open-weight Hy-MT2 translation family, joins the catalog on two BYOK routes.
